# CloudEagle.ai

> > CloudEagle.ai is a SaaS management platform that helps enterprises optimize costs, automate procurement, manage licenses, and govern identity access across their application portfolio.

CloudEagle.ai provides comprehensive SaaS management solutions including cost optimization, vendor management, license tracking, and identity governance. The platform integrates with major tools like Slack, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and SSO providers like Okta to help IT and finance teams eliminate shadow IT, prevent redundant spend, and automate renewal management.

## Key Topics

- SaaS Management
- Cost Optimization
- Shadow IT Detection
- License Management
- Vendor Management
- Application Portfolio Management (APM)
- Identity Governance
- Procurement Automation
- SaaS Spend Management
- Access Management
- Contract Renewals
- SSO Integration
- Microsoft 365
- Slack Integration
- IT Governance

## Core Platform Features

- [Identity Governance Solution For Modern IT Teams](https://www.cloudeagle.ai/product/identity-governance): Automated identity lifecycle, JIT access & self-service app catalog
- [Integrate CloudEagle.ai with Slack for Seamless SaaS Management](https://www.cloudeagle.ai/slack-integration): Slack integration for app access, approvals & renewal alerts
